title: Russian Strikes Kill Six Across Kharkiv and Sumy Regions
detail: Russian strikes killed three people in Balakliya (Kharkiv region) and three more in Sumy region (with 19 wounded, 12 of them in Sumy city) on August 6. Additional strikes wounded two in Dnipropetrovsk and six in Kherson, and killed one crew member aboard the vessel Mera Queen in the Black Sea. Russia's Ministry of Defense said it intercepted 605 Ukrainian drones overnight.

title: Ukraine Strikes Oil Refineries in Bashkortostan and Yaroslavl Regions
detail: Ukrainian long-range drones struck Russian oil refinery targets in the Bashkortostan and Yaroslavl regions on the night of August 5-6, part of Ukraine's continuing campaign against Russia's energy and military-industrial infrastructure deep inside Russian territory.

media.caption: Ukraine's drone campaign continues to target Russian oil refineries
